messages:
marta: Heads up — main CI turned red right after the merge to main. Smoke pipeline hung on `smoke/checkpoint` for >10m. Blocking merges. Anyone able to grab?
ci-bot: CI result: pipeline 2024-05-14T10:22:11Z | job smoke/checkpoint | status: TIMED_OUT | link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98765
allen: I'm looking. Skimming logs now — looks like a lockfile wait at `kvcache::checkpoint`
lucas: I can try a quick rerun for that run id, gimme 2
marta: ty. if rerun flakes again we should bisect the last 3 merges and maybe fallback to previous artifact. No long-running rollbacks unless necessary.
lucas: rerun kicked: `./ci rerun 98765`
ci-bot: Rerun 98765 started. agent: runner-io-5
lucas: Rerun failed same step, ~5m and timed out. attaching minimal log excerpt:
```
[INFO] entering checkpoint
[DEBUG] acquiring kv lock
[ERROR] timeout acquiring kv lock after 300s
```
allen: Thanks. Likely regression in kv prefetcht/evict changes from PR #4321 (merged ~2m before failure). @marta can you flag that PR? I'll start a bisect between HEAD~3..HEAD
marta: @allen dodged - PR 4321 was me — pushing a revert PR now. If bisect quicker, feel free to run it. Also pinging @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: Oncall here, I'll watch the bisect and if revert merges we'll unfreeze queue. Also escalated to eng-infra pager.
allen: Starting automated bisect: `./ci bisect --range HEAD~3..HEAD --test smoke/checkpoint`
ci-bot: Bisect job 98770 queued
lucas: If anyone wants to eyeball logs: https://logs.redwood.example/98765/smoke/checkpoint
marta: If revert needed I'll push and wait on CI green; thanks all. Will update thread.
